stem: Bilal fills two identical plastic bottles. Bottle X has water up to a higher mark than bottle Y. Volume means the space the water occupies, not only each bottle's full capacity.

options.text: Bottle X contains a larger volume of water than bottle Y.
The two identical bottles contain equal volumes of water.
Bottle Y contains a larger volume of water than bottle X.
Bottle X and bottle Y must hold equal volumes because they have the same capacity.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Volume is the space occupied by the water. The higher mark in bottle X means more water, so a larger volume, even though both bottles have the same capacity.

teacher.key_rationale: Identical capacity does not mean equal volumes when the water levels differ. The higher mark shows a larger volume in bottle X. Reversing X and Y, or equating volume with capacity, is wrong.
